subject.title: [Feature]: Support Anthropic native server-side tools (web_search, web_fetch, code_execution)

question: Should OpenClaw support Anthropic web_fetch and code_execution/PTC with allowed_callers as first-class Anthropic plugin behavior, and what opt-in, billing visibility, permission, and replay policy should govern it?
rationale: The remaining work changes provider-hosted execution, tool delegation, auth/provider routing, billing visibility, and transcript replay semantics, so automation should not choose the permanent public API or security default.

options.title: Design gated Anthropic server tools
options.body: Define an explicit opt-in Anthropic plugin and transport design for web_search, web_fetch, code_execution/PTC, allowed_callers, server-result replay, and security tests before implementation.

options.title: Split narrow trackers
options.body: Let narrower items handle native web_search and advisor/server-block behavior while creating separate product decisions for web_fetch and code_execution/PTC.

options.title: Defer hosted execution
options.body: Document that OpenClaw keeps client-side fetch/search and existing code_execution surfaces for now, without Anthropic code_execution/PTC support.

recommendation.title: Design gated Anthropic server tools
recommendation.body: Define an explicit opt-in Anthropic plugin and transport design for web_search, web_fetch, code_execution/PTC, allowed_callers, server-result replay, and security tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest visible product-boundary context from Anthropic plugin work and the prior keep-open review for this exact broad request.
